subject: Compliance readiness: ISO lanes & FedRAMP scenario questions
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance readiness: ISO lanes & FedRAMP scenario questions

Team —

As we start lining up evidence for the next wave of audits, I want to align on two parallel asks: ISO 27001 control mapping (we'll call these the "ISO lanes") and a small FedRAMP readiness exercise driven by a prospective federal customer (AcmeBank). The ask from leadership is: produce a short, pragmatic list of gaps and owners by next Wednesday so we can triage a sprint.

Top-level asks (please reply inline):
1) Confirm owners for each ISO lane (Access Control, Cryptography/KMS, Logging & Monitoring, Asset Management, Change Management).
2) For FedRAMP, we need a scenario: if AcmeBank asks for an audit runbook and 30-day log samples, what are the minimal artifacts we can produce within 2 weeks?
3) Any blockers for providing CAIQ/SIG responses for the scope we currently publish?

I've attached an initial evidence inventory and a simple snapshot matrix (see attachments). Please flag any items you cannot commit to.

Attachments: [evidence_inventory_v1.xlsx (xlsx)], [snapshot_matrix.csv (csv)]

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness: ISO lanes & FedRAMP scenario questions

Thanks, Kim — good framing. Quick notes inline: 

1) Owners: I'm OK to own Logging & Monitoring lane (collectors, retention, SIEM config). Rishi can take Change Management; Marissa you should pick up Asset Management. Aditya can own Cryptography/KMS (unless Aditya thinks otherwise).

2) FedRAMP scenario: for a 30-day sample ask we will need:
  - Snapshot of KMS key inventory + key rotation logs (last 90 days)
  - Export of auth logs for the requested window (we can produce raw logs but need to agree on redaction)
  - Evidence of control narratives (I can draft the narrative for monitoring)

Blockers: KMS key mapping is incomplete for a subset of private deployments (on-prem customers). Aditya, can you surface where the gaps are? I attached our KMS map export.

Attachment: [kms_key_map.pdf (pdf)]

Olga
Senior Security Engineer

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness: ISO lanes & FedRAMP scenario questions

Agree with Olga's split. A few practical considerations for the runbook + sample extraction: 

- Log extraction: we can pull AuthN/AuthZ and runtime inference logs from prod for a 30-day window, but we need to decide whether to provide full tokens/requests or to mask PII. For FedRAMP likely they want full integrity (hashed identifiers) — propose we provide hashed request ids plus full metadata.

- Snapshot cadence: for the FedRAMP ask, we should provide a timebound snapshot (UTC window) plus a short reconciliation doc that shows how snapshots were taken. That will reduce auditor back-and-forth.

- SIG/CAIQ: I've started a lightweight mapping for SIG questions to our current controls and will post a link to the CAIQ draft by EOD. For SOC 2, remind that our current Report is through last quarter; any new controls or infrastructure changes after that will need bridge evidence.

Two asks back to the team:
1) Olga: estimate time to produce log exports for a 30-day window (hours) and whether you need infra help.
2) Aditya: quick note on on-prem KMS gaps and whether we can extract rotation logs for those customers within 48h.

Rishi
Director, Applied Security

From: BlueRiver Audit <audit@blueriver.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-security@acmebank.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 10:31:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Compliance readiness: ISO lanes & FedRAMP scenario questions

Hi Kimberly and team —

Thanks for the heads-up. A few clarifying items from the audit side so you can scope artifacts correctly: 

1) For FedRAMP-like intake, we typically ask for:
   - System flow diagrams and boundary descriptions specific to the AcmeBank integration
   - 30-day auth/log samples (we accept hashed identifiers if linkage to original logs is preserved)
   - KMS key lifecycle records (creation, rotation, deletion events) for the keys in-scope
   - Evidence of personnel access reviews in the sample window

2) CAIQ/SIG: we can pre-scan your CAIQ draft and flag high-risk gaps. Please attach the CAIQ export (json or excel).

3) Timeline: if your team can produce the 30-day exports and the KMS lifecycle logs within 10 business days, we can run a targeted intake review without a full FedRAMP assessment. That review will produce a short gap memo.

Attach: sample_intake_checklist.pdf

If helpful, we can jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow to triage the artifacts.

—BlueRiver Audit (L. Chen)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: BlueRiver Audit <audit@blueriver.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness: ISO lanes & FedRAMP scenario questions

Thanks everyone — helpful and clear. Next steps: 

1) Olga/Rishi: please confirm feasibility and estimated hours for the log and KMS exports by EOD tomorrow. If either of you need infra support, raise a ticket to infra-requests@redwood.com with tag "KMS-EXPORT".
2) Aditya: surface the on-prem KMS customer list and whether rotation logs exist for those tenants (quick note by EOD).
3) Marissa: begin compiling boundary diagrams for the AcmeBank scope (use the Drive folder link).
4) I'll upload the initial CAIQ draft to the Drive and request BlueRiver to pre-scan (see DocuSign link for the NDA if needed).

I'll schedule a 30-minute triage call for Thu 08:30 PT. If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Attachments referenced above are in the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-compliance

Kimberly Park
